The Journal
March 2026

Silence is thinking space

I used to fill every pause when I spoke.

The problem was never that I talked too much. I was speaking before the thought had finished forming.

Now I give the thought a frame before it leaves: what is interesting here, why it matters, and what should happen next.

And I let the silence last a little longer than is comfortable. It is not empty. Something is still being decided in it.
